changes.summary: the sign-in screen: a two-column layout, a private ReadingRoom motif (page, sweeping highlight, drifting peer cursor, note chip, presence pill) and a form with real labels, autocomplete, show/hide password, a pending state and role=alert errors.
adds the screen's own state (submitting, showPassword, togglePassword); the auth contract is unchanged.

decisions: Direction 'the reading room': the brand side draws the workspace's own vocabulary rather than a stock hero.
Exactly one h1 ('Sign in'); the wordmark is a paragraph, so the outline holds on every viewport.
The form's state goes in the hook, not the .tsx (I2).
Motion is the task 036 seam, transform-only; the ambient loops settle under reduced motion.
No credentials or 'demo account' hints in the UI.
